title: GenTel-Safe: A Unified Benchmark and Shielding Framework for Defending Against Prompt Injection Attacks
reasoning: The paper introduces the GenTel-Bench evaluation benchmark, which includes 'Ethical Violation' as one of its six primary security risk scenarios. This category specifically evaluates the detection of prompts that breach moral principles, such as those containing racism, sexism, and other forms of discrimination, making ethics a core component of the benchmarking framework.
